content.short: GMX is a decentralized exchange protocol deployed on Arbitrum and Avalanche, with GMX and GLP as ecosystem tokens.
content.description: GMX is a decentralized exchange protocol deployed on two EVM-compatible networks, Arbitrum and Avalanche. In the Arbitrum ecosystem, GMX serves as the governance and utility token and provides users with about 13% APR. In the Avalanche ecosystem, the corresponding token is GLP, which offers around 21% APR. The project also offers an API that enables developers to tap into its trading and liquidity infrastructure, supporting programmatic access to its features.
